scope: Representative genuine captures inspected visually; behavior is established by the separate runner evidence.
findings: Starting quantities remain visible during work-area scrolling.
Pond and picnic scenery introduces no extra countable dinosaurs or apples.
Inspected text wraps legibly, including German 1.5x portrait and 2x landscape.
Long work areas scroll; partial text at a scroll boundary is expected.
Component captures omit the production shell and can show keyboard focus.
Canonical apple artwork retains its ivory image background.
limits: Emulator display override is not physical tablet validation.
Voice audibility, real TalkBack/switch use and child comprehension were not assessed.
